reason: I don't know this company and no salon owner or distributor I know is using it, so I'm not paying ₹4,999 upfront and moving all my customers onto it. The cash-drawer and cancelled-bill checks do sound useful, but my register works and nobody has lost data from a notebook.
objection: If the phone breaks or this company shuts down, where do my customer numbers and wallet balances go? And after losing two stylists last year, I don't want my staff to have all my customers' numbers on their phones.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running at another salon owner's shop near me for a few months, and them telling me the data is safe even when a phone is lost.
